exposure: Management of childbirth (external cephalic version (ECV) plus planned vaginal delivery (PVD))
Planned caesarean section for breech presentation
outcome: Rate of breech presentation at delivery
Rate of caesarean section (CS) indication for breech presentation
Rate of CS for breech presentation out of total deliveries
Umbilical cord arterial pH and acid-base analysis
cohort: The study participants were 2377 singleton breech pregnancies at term from the Obstetrics and Gynaecology Service, Cruces University Hospital.
finding: Management of breech presentation with a protocol including ECV, careful selection criteria, and active management of vaginal delivery significantly decreased the rate of CS for breech presentation.
mod_finding: Early postnatal parameters (5-min Apgar score, umbilical cord arterial pH and acid-base analysis) were significantly lower following planned vaginal delivery compared with planned CS for breech presentation.
